word_for_word: किंच -- गतिरिति।
Further: ‘the goal.’
गम्यत इति गतिः। फलम्
‘Gati’ is that which is reached, the fruit.
भर्ता पोषणकर्ता
‘Bhartā’ is the nourisher.
प्रभुः नियन्ता
‘Prabhu’ is the ruler.
साक्षी शुभाशुभद्रष्टा
‘Witness’ is the observer of good and evil.
निवासः भोगस्थानम्
‘Abode’ is the place of experience.
शरणं रक्षकः
‘Refuge’ is the protector.
सुहृद्धितकर्ता
‘Friend’ is the benefactor.
प्रकर्षेण भवत्यनेनेति प्रभवः स्रष्टा
‘Origin’ means creator, that by which things come forth eminently.
प्रलीयतेऽनेनेति प्रलयः संहर्ता
‘Dissolution’ means destroyer, that by which things dissolve.
तिष्ठन्त्यस्मिन्निति स्थानमाधारः
‘Foundation’ is the support in which things remain.
निधीयतेऽस्मिन्निति निधानं लयस्थानम्
‘Repository’ is the place into which things are deposited at dissolution.
बीजं कारणम्
‘Seed’ means cause.
तथाप्यव्ययमविनाशि नतु व्रीह्यादिबीजवन्नश्वरमित्यर्थः।
Yet that seed is imperishable, not perishable like seeds of rice and the like; this is the meaning.
किंच -- तपामीति।
Further: ‘I give heat.’
आदित्यात्मना स्थितत्वान्निदाघसमये तपामि जगतस्तापं करोमि
Existing as the sun, in the hot season I heat the world and cause its heat.
वृष्टिसमये च वर्षमुत्सृजामि विमुञ्चामि कदाचित्तु वर्षं निगृह्णामि आकर्षामि
In the rainy season I release rain; at times I withhold and draw back rain.
अमृतं जीवनं मृत्युश्च नाशः
I am immortality, life, and death, destruction.
सत्स्थूलं दृश्यम् असच्च सूक्ष्ममदृश्यम्
‘Sat’ is the gross and visible; ‘asat’ is the subtle and invisible.
एतत्सर्वमहमेवेति मत्वा मामेव बहुधा उपासत इति पूर्वेणैवान्वयः।
Thinking that all this is I alone, they worship Me in many ways; the construction continues from the preceding statement.
तदेवम् ... अभक्ता दर्शिताः।
Thus in the two verses beginning ‘Fools disregard Me,’ non-devotees were shown as worshipping other deities in hope of quick fruit and not honoring Me.
महात्मानस्तु ... च भक्ता उक्ताः
And in the verses beginning ‘But the great souls,’ devotees were described.
तत्रैकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन वा परमेश्वरं श्रीवासुदेवं ये न भजन्ति तेषां जन्ममृत्युप्रवाहो दुर्वार इत्याह -- त्रैविद्या मामिति द्वाभ्याम्।

Now He says in two verses beginning ‘The knowers of the three Vedas’ that for those who do not worship the Supreme Lord Śrī Vāsudeva either in unity or distinction, the stream of birth and death is hard to cross.
ऋग्यजुःसामलक्षणास्तिस्रो विद्या येषां ते त्रिविद्याः एव त्रैविद्याः स्वार्थे तद्धितः।
Those whose three sciences are Ṛg, Yajus and Sāman are ‘trividyā’; ‘traividyā’ is a derivative in the same sense.
तिस्रो विद्या अधीयन्ते जानन्तीति वा त्रैविद्याः। वेदत्रयोक्तकर्मतत्परा इत्यर्थः।
Or they are called ‘traividyā’ because they study or know the three Vedas; the meaning is that they are devoted to the rites enjoined in the three Vedas.
वेदत्रयविहितैर्यज्ञैर्मामिष्ट्वा ममैव रूपं देवतान्तरमित्यजानन्तोऽपि वस्तुत इन्द्रादिरूपेण मामेवेष्ट्वा संपूज्य
By sacrifices prescribed in the three Vedas they sacrifice to Me; though not knowing that the other deities are forms of Me, in reality they worship Me alone in forms such as Indra.
यज्ञशेषं सोमं पिबन्तीति सोमपाः तेनैव पूतपापाः शोधितकल्मषाः सन्तः
They drink Soma left from sacrifice and are therefore Soma-drinkers; by that very act their sins are purified and their stains cleansed.
स्वर्गतिं स्वर्गं प्रति गतिं ये प्रार्थयन्ते ते पुण्यफलरूपं सुरेन्द्रस्य लोकं स्वर्गमासाद्य प्राप्य दिवि स्वर्गे दिव्यानुत्तमान्देवानां भोगानश्नन्ति भुञ्जते।
Desiring the path to heaven, they reach the world of the lord of the gods, heaven, which is the fruit of merit, and there enjoy the unsurpassed divine enjoyments of the gods.
ततश्च -- ते तं भुक्त्वेति।
Then: ‘Having enjoyed that.’
ते स्वर्गकामास्तं प्रार्थितं विपुलं स्वर्गलोकं तत्सुखं भुक्त्वा
Those seekers of heaven, having enjoyed the vast heavenly world and its pleasures that they desired,
भोगप्रापके पुण्ये क्षीणे सति मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।
when the merit that produced those enjoyments is exhausted, enter the mortal world.
पुनरप्येवमेव वेदत्रय्या विहितं धर्ममनुसृताः कामकामा भोगान्कामयमाना गतागतं यातायातं लभन्ते।
Again in the same way, following the dharma prescribed by the three Vedas and desiring objects of enjoyment, they obtain coming and going, repeated arrival and departure.
मद्भक्तास्तु मत्प्रसादेन कृतार्था भवन्तीत्याह -- अनन्या इति।
But My devotees become fulfilled through My grace; He says: ‘Those who are exclusive.’
अनन्या नास्ति मद्व्यतिरेकेणान्यत्काम्यं भजनीयं देवतान्तरं येषां
‘Exclusive’ means those for whom there is nothing else apart from Me to be desired or worshipped, no other deity.
तथाभूता ये जना मां चिन्तयन्तः सेवन्ते
Such people contemplate Me and serve Me.
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां सर्वदा मदेकनिष्ठानां
For those who are constantly united, always established in Me alone,
योगं धनादिलाभं क्षेमं च तत्पालनं मोक्षं वा तैरप्रार्थितमप्यहमेव वहामि प्रापयामि।
I Myself carry and procure their yoga, acquisition such as wealth, and kṣema, preservation of what is acquired, or liberation—even though they do not ask for it.
ननु च त्वद्व्यतिरेकेण वस्तुतो देवतान्तरस्याभावादिन्द्रादिसेविनोऽपि त्वद्भक्ता एवेति कथं ते गतागतं लभेरंस्तत्राह -- येऽपीति।
But since in reality no deity exists apart from You, worshippers of Indra and others are also Your devotees; how then do they undergo coming and going? He answers: ‘Even those.’
श्रद्धयोपेता भक्ताः सन्तो येऽपि जना यज्ञेनान्यदेवता इन्द्रादिरूपा यजन्ते तेऽपि मामेव यजन्तीति सत्यम्
It is true that those faithful devotees who sacrifice to other deities such as Indra also sacrifice to Me alone.
किंत्वविधिपूर्वकं मोक्षप्रापकं विधिं विना यजन्त्यतस्ते पुनरावर्तन्ते।
But they worship without the proper rule, without the method that leads to liberation; therefore they return again.
एतदेव विवृणोति -- अहं हीति।
He explains this very point: ‘For I.’
सर्वेषां यज्ञानां तत्तद्देवतारूपेणाहमेव भोक्ता प्रभुश्च स्वामी फलदातापि चाहमेवेत्यर्थः।
In the form of each deity, I alone am the enjoyer of all sacrifices, their Lord and master, and I alone am the giver of their fruits; this is the meaning.
एवंभूतं मां ते तत्त्वेन यथावन्नाभिजानन्ति अतश्च्यवन्ति प्रच्यवन्ते पुनरावर्तन्ते।
They do not know Me, who am such, truly and as I am; therefore they fall away and return again.
येतु सर्वदेवतासु मामेवान्तर्यामिणं पश्यन्तो यजन्ति ते तु नावर्तन्ते।
But those who sacrifice while seeing Me alone as the inner controller in all deities do not return.
तदेवोपपादयति -- यान्तीति।
He establishes that point: ‘They go.’
देवेष्विन्द्रादिषु व्रतं नियमो येषां ते अन्तवन्तो देवान्यान्ति अतः पुनरावर्तन्ते।
Those whose vow and observance is directed to gods such as Indra go to the finite gods; therefore they return.
पितृषु व्रतं येषां श्राद्धादिक्रियापराणां ते पितृ़न्यान्ति।
Those whose vow is toward the ancestors, devoted to śrāddha and related rites, go to the ancestors.
भूतेषु विनायकमातृकादिष्विज्या पूजा येषां ते भूतानि यान्ति।
Those whose worship is directed to beings such as Vināyakas and Mātṛkās go to those beings.
मां यष्टुं शीलं येषां ते मद्याजिनस्ते तु मामक्षयं परमानन्दरूपं नारायणं यान्ति।
Those whose practice is to sacrifice to Me are My worshippers; they go to Me, imperishable Nārāyaṇa whose nature is supreme bliss.
तदेवं स्वभक्तानामक्षयफलत्वमुक्तम्। अनायासत्वं स्वभक्तेर्दर्शयति -- पत्रमिति।
Thus the inexhaustible fruit of His devotees has been stated. He now shows how effortless devotion to Him is: ‘A leaf.’
पत्रपुष्पादिमात्रमपि मह्यं भक्त्या प्रीत्या यः प्रयच्छति
Whoever offers Me even merely a leaf, flower and the like with devotion and love,
तस्य प्रयतात्मनः शुद्धचित्तस्य निष्कामभक्तस्य तत्पत्रपुष्पादिकं तेन भक्त्योपहृतं समर्पितमहमश्नामि प्रीत्या गृह्णामि।
from that self-controlled, pure-minded, desireless devotee I eat—that is, lovingly accept—the leaf, flower and so forth offered with devotion.
नहि महाविभूतिपतेः परमेश्वरस्य मम क्षुद्रदेवतानामिव बहुवित्तसाध्ययागादिभिः परितोषः स्यात् किंतु भक्तिमात्रेण।
For I, the Supreme Lord and master of immense majesty, am not pleased, like minor deities, by sacrifices requiring great wealth, but by devotion alone.
अतो भक्तेन समर्पितं यत्किंचित्पत्रादिमात्रमपि तदनुग्रहार्थमेवाश्नामीति भावः।
Therefore I accept even the smallest leaf and the like offered by a devotee solely in order to bestow grace upon that devotee; this is the purport.
नच पत्रपुष्पादिकमपि यज्ञार्थं पशुसोमादिद्रव्यवन्मदर्थमेवोद्यमैरापाद्य समर्पणीयम् किं तर्हि -- यदिति।
Nor must even a leaf, flower and the like be specially procured with effort for My sake as sacrificial materials such as animals or Soma are procured for a sacrifice. What then? He says: ‘Whatever.’
स्वभावतो वा शास्त्रतो वा यत्किंचित्कर्म करोषि
Whatever action you perform, whether naturally or because scripture enjoins it,
तथा यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि यद्ददासि यत्तपस्यसि तपः करोषि
whatever you eat, offer in fire, give away, or practice as austerity,
तत्सर्वं मय्यर्पितं यथा भवत्येवं कुरुष्व।
do all of it in such a way that it is offered to Me.
एवं च यत्फलं प्राप्स्यसि तच्छृणु -- शुभेति।
Hear the fruit you will obtain by doing so: ‘From good and evil fruits.’
एवं कुर्वन्कर्मबन्धनैः कर्मनिमित्तैरिष्टानिष्टैः फलैर्मुक्तो भविष्यसि।
Acting thus, you will become free from the bonds of karma, the agreeable and disagreeable fruits produced by action.
कर्मणां मयि समर्पितत्वेन तव तत्फलसंबन्धानुपपत्तेः।
For when actions have been offered to Me, their fruits cannot properly become connected with you.
तैश्च विमुक्तः सन्संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा संन्यासः कर्मणां मदर्पणं स एव योगस्तेन युक्त आत्मा चित्तं यस्य तथाभूतस्त्वं मां प्राप्स्यसि।
Freed from those fruits, with a mind joined to the yoga of renunciation—renunciation here being the offering of actions to Me, and that itself being yoga—you will attain Me.
यदि भक्तेभ्य एव मोक्षं ददासि नाभक्तेभ्यश्च तर्हि तवापि किं रागद्वेषादिकृतं वैषम्यमस्ति? नेत्याह -- सम इति।
If You give liberation only to devotees and not to non-devotees, do You then show partiality caused by attachment and aversion? No; He says: ‘I am equal.’
समोऽहं सर्वेष्वपि भूतेषु। अतो मे मम प्रियश्च द्वेष्यश्च नास्त्येव।
I am equal toward all beings; therefore there is no one dear or hateful to Me.
एवंसत्यपि ये मां भजन्ति ते भक्ता मयि वर्तन्ते। अहमपि तेष्वनुग्राहकतया वर्ते।
Even so, those devotees who worship Me abide in Me, and I abide in them as the bestower of grace.
अयं भावः -- यथाग्नेः स्वसेवकेष्वेव तमःशीतादिदुःखमपाकुर्वतोऽपि न वैषम्यं यथावा कल्पवृक्षस्य तथैव भक्तपक्षपातिनोऽपि मम न वैषम्यं किंतु मद्भक्तेरेवं महिमेति।

The purport is: fire is not partial though it removes darkness, cold and suffering only for those who approach it, nor is a wish-fulfilling tree partial. Likewise, though I favor My devotees, there is no partiality in Me; rather, such is the greatness of devotion to Me.
अपिच मद्भक्तेरवितर्क्यः प्रभाव इति दर्शयन्नाह -- अपिचेदिति।
Further, to show that the power of devotion to Me is beyond reasoning, He says: ‘Even if.’
अत्यन्तं दुराचारोऽपि यद्यप्यपृथक्त्वेन पृथग्देवता अपि वासुदेव एवेति बुद्ध्या नरो देवतान्तरभक्तिमकुर्वन्मामेव श्रीनारायणं भजते
Even a man of extremely bad conduct, if with the understanding that even distinct deities are none other than Vāsudeva, gives up devotion to other deities and worships Me alone, Śrī Nārāyaṇa,
तर्हि साधुः श्रेष्ठ एव स मन्तव्यः।
must then be regarded as a sādhu, indeed excellent.
यतोऽसौ सम्यग्व्यवसितः परमेश्वरभजनेनैव कृतार्थो भविष्यामीति शोभनमध्यवसायं कृतवान्।
For he has resolved rightly, having formed the good determination: ‘By worshipping the Supreme Lord alone I shall become fulfilled.’
ननु कथं समीचीनाध्यवसायमात्रेण साधुर्मन्तव्यस्तत्राह -- क्षिप्रमिति।
But how can he be regarded as a sādhu merely because of a proper resolve? He says: ‘Quickly.’
दुराचारोऽपि मां भजञ्छीघ्रं धर्मचित्तो भवति।
Even one of bad conduct, by worshipping Me, quickly becomes righteous in mind.
ततश्च शश्वच्छान्तिं शाश्वतीमुपशान्तिं चित्तोपप्लवोपरमरूपां परमेश्वरनिष्ठां नितरां गच्छति प्राप्नोति।
Then he thoroughly attains lasting peace, an abiding tranquillity consisting in the cessation of mental disturbance and steadfastness in the Supreme Lord.
कुतर्ककर्कशवादिनो नैतन्मन्येरन्निति शङ्काव्याकुलचित्तमर्जुनं प्रोत्साहयति।
He encourages Arjuna, whose mind might be troubled by the thought that harsh disputants using false reasoning would not accept this.
हे कौन्तेय पटहकाहलादिमहाघोषपूर्वकं विवदमानानां सभां गत्वा बाहुमुत्क्षिप्य निःशङ्कं प्रतिजानीहि प्रतिज्ञां कुरु।
O son of Kuntī, go to the assembly of disputants, with the loud sound of drums and trumpets, raise your arm, and fearlessly make this proclamation.
कथं? मे परमेश्वरस्य भक्तः सुदुराचारोऽपि न प्रणश्यति अपितु कृतार्थ एव भवतीति।
What proclamation? ‘A devotee of Me, the Supreme Lord, even if of very bad conduct, does not perish but surely becomes fulfilled.’
ततश्च ते त्वत्प्रौढिविजृम्भाद्विध्वंसितकुतर्का निःसंशयं त्वामेव गुरुत्वेनाश्रयेरन्।
Then, their false arguments shattered by the force of your confidence, they will without doubt take refuge in you as teacher.
आचारभ्रष्टं मद्भक्तिः पवित्रीकरोतीति किमत्र चित्रम्?
What wonder is there that devotion to Me purifies one fallen from proper conduct?
यतो मद्भक्तिर्दुष्कुलानप्यनधिकारिणोऽपि संसारान्मोचयतीत्याह -- मां हीति।
For devotion to Me frees from saṃsāra even those of low birth and those otherwise unqualified; He says: ‘For taking refuge in Me.’
येऽपि पापयोनयः स्युः निकृष्टजन्मानोऽन्त्यजादयो भवेयुः
Even those of sinful birth, of low birth such as outcastes,
येऽपि वैश्याः केवलं कृष्यादिनिरताः स्त्रियः शूद्रादयश्चाध्ययनादिरहिताः
and Vaiśyas occupied only with agriculture and the like, women, Śūdras and others without Vedic study,
तेऽपि मां व्यपाश्रित्य संसेव्य परां गतिं यान्ति। हि निश्चितम्।
even they, taking full refuge in Me and serving Me, attain the supreme goal. ‘Hi’ indicates certainty.
यदेवं तदा सत्कुलाः सदाचाराश्च मद्भक्ताः परां गतिं यान्तीति किं वक्तव्यमित्याह -- किमिति।
If this is so, what need is there to say that My devotees of good family and conduct attain the supreme goal? He says: ‘How much more.’
पुण्याः सुकृतिनो ब्राह्मणाः।
‘Holy Brāhmaṇas’ means Brāhmaṇas of meritorious conduct.
तथा राजानश्च ते ऋषयश्च क्षत्रियाः।
Likewise ‘royal seers’ are kings who are also seers, Kṣatriyas.
एवंभूताः परां गतिं यान्तीति किं वक्तव्यमित्यर्थः।
What need is there to say that persons of this kind attain the supreme goal? This is the meaning.
अतस्त्वमिमं राजर्षिरूपं लोकं देहं प्राप्य लब्ध्वा मां भजस्व।
Therefore, having obtained this body and condition of a royal seer, worship Me.
किंच अनित्यमध्रुवमसुखं सुखरहितमिमं मर्त्यलोकं प्राप्यानित्यत्वाद्विलम्बमकुर्वन् असुखत्वाच्च सुखार्थोद्यमं हित्वा मामेव भजस्वेत्यर्थः।

Moreover, having reached this mortal world which is impermanent, unstable and devoid of true happiness, do not delay because it is impermanent, and abandoning effort for worldly pleasure because it is joyless, worship Me alone.
भजनप्रकारं दर्शयन्नुपसंहरति -- मन्मना इति।
Showing the manner of worship, He concludes: ‘Fix your mind on Me.’
मय्येव मनो यस्य स मन्मनास्त्वं भव।
Become one whose mind is in Me alone.
तथैव ममैव भक्तः मत्सेवको भव।
Likewise become My devotee, My servant.
मद्याजी मद्यजनशीलो भव।
Become one whose practice is to worship Me.
मामेव च नमस्कुरु।
Bow to Me alone.
एवमेभिः प्रकारैर्मत्परायणः सन्नात्मानं मनो मयि युक्त्वा समाधाय मामेव परमानन्दरूपमेष्यसि प्राप्स्यसि।
Thus, making Me your supreme goal and joining and fixing your mind in Me by these practices, you will reach Me alone, whose nature is supreme bliss.
